'''''UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs. Malott''''' (also known as '''''UFC Fight Night 291''''') is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that is scheduled to take place on October 17, 2026, at [[Rogers Place]] in [[Edmonton]], [[Alberta]], Canada.<ref name="Edmonton">{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/07/19/ufc-edmonton-fight-card-announcement-canada/90974963007/|title=UFC announces second Edmonton card in less than two years|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-07-19|access-date=2026-07-20}}</ref>

==Background==
The event will mark the promotion's fourth visit to Edmonton and first since [[UFC Fight Night: Moreno vs. Albazi]] in November 2024.<ref name="Edmonton" />

A welterweight bout between [[Joaquin Buckley]] and [[Mike Malott]] is scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/ufc/article/canadas-mike-malott-to-headline-ufc-fight-night-in-edmonton/|title=Canada's Mike Malott to headline UFC Fight Night in Edmonton|publisher=sportsnet.ca|author=Staff|date=2026-07-28|access-date=2026-07-29}}</ref>

A women's flyweight bout between [[Erin Blanchfield]] and [[Jasmine Jasudavicius]] is scheduled to serve as the co-main event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2026/07/23/erin-blanchfield-jasmine-jasudavicius-shifts-from-ufc-330-targeted-edmonton/|title=Erin Blanchfield vs. Jasmine Jasudavicius shifts from UFC 330, targeted for Edmonton|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson|date=2026-07-23|access-date=2026-07-28}}</ref> They were initially scheduled to compete at [[UFC 330]] in August, but Blanchfield withdrew due to an injury.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://boxingnews.com/news/erin-blanchfield-jasmine-jasudavicius-ufc-330|title=Erin Blanchfield vs. Jasmine Jasudavicius set for UFC 330|publisher=boxingnews.com|author=Tom Rashid|date=2026-06-18|access-date=2026-07-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/07/23/ufc-330-loses-top-contender-bout-philadelphia-fight-card/91022863007/|title=UFC 330 loses Erin Blanchfield vs. Jasmine Jasudavicius|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-07-27|access-date=2026-07-23}}</ref>

A women's flyweight bout between former [[UFC Women's Flyweight Championship]] challenger [[Katlyn Cerminara]] and former [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Women's Flyweight Championship|LFA Women's Flyweight Champion]] Jamey-Lyn Horth was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/08/10/ufc-edmonton-four-new-fights-added-october-event/91249622007/|title=UFC Fight Night 291 adds four matchups to Edmonton event|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Matthew Wells|date=2026-08-10|access-date=2026-09-28}}</ref> However, Horth had to withdraw due to an injury and was replaced by promotional newcomer Mackenzie Stiller.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.squamishchief.com/local-sports/update-squamishs-jamey-lyn-horth-forced-to-withdraw-from-ufc-fight-due-to-injury-12697243|title=Update: Squamish's Jamey-Lyn Horth forced to withdraw from UFC fight due to injury|publisher=squamishchief.com|author=Jennifer Thuncher|date=2026-09-28|access-date=2026-09-28}}</ref><ref name="Stiller">{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/fannation/mma/news/ex-ufc-title-challenger-gets-new-opponent-just-weeks-out-from-ufc-edmonton|title=Ex-UFC title challenger gets new opponent just weeks out from UFC Edmonton|publisher=si.com|author=Drew Beaupre|date=2026-10-01|access-date=2026-10-02}}</ref>

A heavyweight bout between promotional newcomer [[Javad Mahjoub]] and Louie Sutherland was originally scheduled at the event, but Sutherland pulled out and was replaced by fellow promotional newcomer Joel Faglier.<ref name="Faglier">{{Cite web|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/ufc/article/faglier-to-replace-sutherland-at-ufc-edmonton/|title=Faglier to replace Sutherland at UFC Edmonton|publisher=sportsnet.ca|author=Staff|date=2026-09-30|access-date=2026-10-02}}</ref>

In addition, a middleweight bout between Julien Leblanc and Gilbert Urbina was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ici.radio-canada.ca/nouvelle/2276116/julien-leblanc-marc-andre-barriault-ufc-edmonton|title=Un rêve se réalisera pour des Gatinois lors du UFC Fight Night|publisher=ici.radio-canada.ca|author=Martin Comtois|date=2026-08-19|access-date=2026-10-01}} {{in lang|fr}}</ref> However, Urbina withdrew for undisclosed reasons and was replaced by promotional newcomer Nick Galanti.<ref name="Galanti">{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/10/01/ufc-edmonton-nick-galanti-vs-julien-leblanc-middleweight-mma-fight-booking-gilbert-urbina-out/92041488007/|title=Recent quick DWCS winner books short-notice debut for UFC Edmonton|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Staff|date=2026-10-01|access-date=2026-10-02}}</ref>
